sectionTagDescription: Life brings different challenges in different seasons. Together, we’ll focus on the areas that matter most to you right now.

services.title: Clarity & Purpose
services.description: Cut through the noise. Reconnect with what actually matters and design a life that feels like your own — not one you inherited or performed.

services.title: Confidence Rebuild
services.description: Release the self-doubt running in the background. Step into rooms — and decisions — with quiet authority and trust in your own judgment.

services.title: Relationships & Boundaries
services.description: Heal the patterns that keep repeating. Learn to communicate, hold space, and choose yourself without guilt or overexplaining.

services.title: Career Transitions
services.description: Whether you're pivoting, building, or finally leaving — get a roadmap that respects both your ambition and your soul.

services.title: Emotional Mastery
services.description: Move from reacting to responding. Build tools you'll use for the rest of your life — not just for our sessions together.

services.title: Motherhood & Identity
services.description: Reclaim the woman underneath the roles. Coaching for the season of life that asks the most of you — and gives the most back.
